support_on_critical_faces.required: no support may land on a preserve surface
support_on_critical_faces.note: support rests on 2 preserve voxel(s) (32.0 mm2). Those faces come off the printer rough and out of tolerance. Reorient the part, or accept the finish and say so explicitly.

enclosed_support.required: no support inside a sealed cavity
enclosed_support.note: all support is reachable from outside

note: measured on the voxel grid, so overhang angles are only 0 or 90 degrees. A 60-degree face that would self-support is not counted here; `topopt overhang` reads real angles off the STL.
